[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a nurse practitioner at Demo Regional Hospital (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 21-year-old female patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their first dose of DemoGlutide (dose: 2 mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-07-28.
Approximately 1 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed a severe injection site reaction with necrosis at the injection site.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
D. Silva (fictional reporter)
Demo Regional Hospital
